home.classesSubtitle: From strength to stillness - find the practice that meets you where you are.

classCards.body: Low-impact, full-body movement on the reformer, where spring resistance can support you or challenge you - meeting you exactly where you are. It builds core strength, tones the whole body, and improves posture and flexibility, while staying gentle on the joints.

Pilates in its purest form, using only your own body on the mat. Controlled, deliberate movements that build a strong foundation - deep core strength, better posture, and a clearer sense of how your body moves.

For the days you want to build heat. A faster tempo and flowing transitions turn the Pilates method into something more dynamic - stronger, more intense, and deeply engaging, while never losing precision or control.
Breath and movement, woven together. Sessions to stretch, ground, and soften - space to release the day and return to yourself.
Targeted stretches designed to release tension and create space within the joints and muscles.

story.title: About Ommm.
story.lede: A women's wellness space in the heart of Yerevan — created for movement, calm, and the moment that belongs only to you.
story.featurePauseBody: Every detail invites you to slow down — from the first breath at the door to the quiet after class. This is time set aside for you, without rush or noise.
story.featureCalmBody: Soft light, natural textures, and thoughtful flow through the studio keep the space gentle on the senses. Movement and rest share the same unhurried rhythm.
story.valuesSubtitle: What we stand for in the studio — movement, calm, and community.
story.valuePeaceBody: Classes and rituals that help you arrive in the present — breath, focus, and release from the day behind you.
story.valueStrengthBody: Movement that builds from the inside out — aligned, intentional, and tuned to your body, not someone else's pace.
story.valueCommunityBody: A circle of women who show up for themselves and each other — shared energy without comparison or pressure.
story.closingBody: The name carries the sound of an extended exhale — the space between effort and ease. Three letters, one long breath, and a reminder that harmony is something you can return to.
story.closingCallout: This is your moment of harmony.
